_comment: Recorded gaps of the generated field suite (FC3). Each entry is a field/transport/band that does not yet satisfy its assertion. A reason is mandatory, the id is an FC3-n deferral id in plan_docs/gcp-defect-coverage-wave-plan.md, and review_by is a future date. An entry that stops failing fails the suite as stale, so this file is a ratchet: it may shrink, never silently grow.
